symptom: A low-weight caramel-workshop terminal branch distilled from 3237 selective ranked rule-bot victory samples plus 164 clean risk rows passed the offline action-distribution guard, but did not convert caramel-workshop in the 300s high-pressure comparison. The fixed-window result stayed soda-creek 1.0, caramel-workshop 0.0, cracked-star-jar 0.3333, and caramel-workshop average survival dropped from the per-map chain baseline 231.2871s to 230.8648s.
root_cause: The selective ranked victory samples improve offline nearest action agreement for the failing traces, but the supervised terminal branch still imitates isolated late-window actions rather than a robust online conversion sequence. The branch was dispatched 832 times on caramel-workshop during the 300s comparison, including 832 late-window decisions, but it did not produce a victory and caused a larger survival regression than the prior full-neighbor terminal branch.
fix: Do not promote this checkpoint as a policy candidate, stage 03 model, RL test Bot, or acceptance evidence. Keep the per-map edge branch plus all-map late filter as the current diagnostic baseline. Pause further simple supervised terminal-path imitation variants from rule-bot victories until the next repair changes the objective, for example by collecting direct successful target-seed traces, adding a constrained online/sequence objective, or adding sequence-level terminal conversion validation before branch evaluation.
